messages:
priya (sales): FYI FinCorp just flagged errors on their Dedicated pool after maintenance. embeddings endpoint returning 500s for a subset of requests. They're on v2.3.1 and it's hitting prod. They want a patch ASAP, tagging @maria for product decision.

maria (pm): Thanks. Quick triage first: can we repro? How widespread is it? Need to decide hotfix vs next release. Any rollback complexity?

sarah (support): ~120 500s in last 45m, majority from FinCorp prod. Logs show `KV cache OOM` + `model->init failed`. Repro request id 46f2c1 — I'm uploading traces. Affected: FinCorp Dedicated pool only. :eyes:  

liam (eng-lead): Can we repro on a dedicated snapshot? If it's a cache threshold/regression we might ship a config-only hotfix. If kernel/quant change -> next release. What's our rollback story?

ken (oncall): Recommend canary patch: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health checks and abort rules. I can coordinate the rollout and rollback. Need the deploy plan and short checklist.

maria (pm): Proposed decision rule: if fix is <=1 PR, runtime config or guardrail only -> hotfix. If it touches kernels/quantization or model weights -> schedule for next minor release. Sound good? @liam

liam (eng-lead): Agreed. Initial assessment: likely kvcache threshold + defensive check. I'll prepare a PR and tests. Target hotfix window 3-4h if no surprises.

sarah (support): I'll produce the failing request list and run a repro harness against staging dedicated snapshot now.

priya (sales): I'll tell FinCorp we're doing a phased patch and give ETA ~4h, will provide canary metrics and updates. Keep me looped for comms.

deploy-bot: Started canary deploy `hotfix/kvcache-threshold` to pool `dedicated-fincorp` at 2026-03-20T10:12:00Z (5%).

liam (eng-lead): PR submitted: #3427 — bump kvcache threshold + safety check. Running unit + integration. cc @ken for canary steps.

ken (oncall): Canary run plan: step1 5% for 15m monitor (errors, latency, OOMs), step2 25% 15m, step3 100%. Abort conditions: error rate >1% or p95 latency regression >20%. Prometheus queries: `sum(rate(api_errors[5m])) by (pool)` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool))`.

maria (pm): QA checklist: replay failing requests, smoke test embeddings, run 2x load test baseline, update runbook, prep customer comms. Create postmortem ticket for root cause.

sarah (support): Repro run: 46/120 failing repro in staging. Stack snippet: ```error: kv cache exceeded capacity -> evict failed``` — attaching logs.

liam (eng-lead): Kicking canary now. @ken please watch the metrics.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 25% (2026-03-20T10:34:00Z).

ken (oncall): Metrics look green so far. p95 up ~5%, error rate back to baseline. Proceeding to 100%.

deploy-bot: Canary completed to 100% (2026-03-20T10:50:00Z).

priya (sales): Messaged FinCorp: "Patch deployed to your Dedicated pool, monitoring ongoing. Will send a follow-up postmortem." They responded :thumbsup:.

maria (pm): Hotfix shipped. Leaving a backlog item for a permanent fix + regression test, assign to @liam. Follow-up: add e2e for kvcache eviction scenarios and a guardrail alert. Great work team.
